claim.value: Inconclusive results call for additional trials only within the available budget.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the inconclusive outcome, additional-trial response and budget restriction.

signal_basis.value: Repeated export trials yield an inconclusive classification when the prespecified evidence supports neither the acceptable nor the elevated tail-rate range. Additional trials are budget-limited, and an unresolved interval remains when further classification is infeasible.
signal_basis.scope: Revision classification using observed one-hour exceedance rates and their uncertainty, subject to the testing budget.

provenance.rationale: These spans establish the measurements, inconclusive classification rule, bounded additional testing and stopping outcome.
The bounded procedural claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An inconclusive classification leaves the revision unresolved under the stated evidence rule. Additional trials within the budget are a licensed procedural response. The claim promises neither decisive classification nor testing beyond the budget.
uncertainty: Additional trials may remain inconclusive; this does not undermine the bounded response claimed.
